title: You Can't Keep a Single Fish in GTA 6 (But Hunting Pays) 🎣 #Shorts
description:
Fishing in GTA 6 is catch and release only. Rockstar North's Rob Nelson told TGG that fishing is about as detailed as Red Dead Redemption 2, but keeping the fish "didn't fit" this game, so every fish goes back in the water and fishing pays nothing. Hunting is the opposite: you kill animals and sell what you get for cash, and it unlocks through a character who already knows Jason. Nelson also told Famitsu that just completing missions won't give you enough money to progress the story.

Sources: GameSpot (GTA 6 Fishing And Hunting Doesn't Work Like You Think It Does), Notebookcheck (Rob Nelson interviews with TGG and Famitsu).
